title: Alcohol use disorder: severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's alcohol use, if any is reportable.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for alcohol use disorder.

HPI: Pt is an 85-year-old female presenting for follow-up of alcohol use disorder, moderate. Pt reports she has not consumed any alcohol for over a year. She reports she feels stable and denies any cravings or urges to drink. She is currently compliant with her treatment plan and reports a good quality of life. She denies any recent falls, changes in mood, or sleep disturbances.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg QD
- Atorvastatin 20mg QD
- Multivitamin daily

Review of Systems:
General: No fatigue, no weight changes.
HEENT: No vision changes, no hearing loss.
CV: No chest pain, no palpitations.
Resp: No SOB, no cough.
GI: No abdominal pain, no changes in bowel habits.
MSK: No joint pain, no stiffness.
Neuro: No tremors, no memory issues.

Social History: Lives with daughter. Retired. Denies tobacco use.

Family History: Mother had hypertension. Father had type 2 diabetes.

Vitals:
BP: 132/80
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 98% on RA
Ht: 12.4
Wt: 145 lbs

Recent Labs:
eGFR: 65
HbA1c: 5.8%
TSH: 2.1

Exam:
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
CV: RRR, no murmurs.
Lungs: CTAB.
Abd: Soft, non-tender, no organomegaly.
Ext: WNL, no edema.

Assessment:
1. Alcohol use disorder, moderate. Pt is in sustained remission. She has been abstinent for over 12 months and remains stable.
2. Hypertension. Well-controlled on current meds.
3. Hyperlipidemia. Stable.

Plan:
1. Alcohol use disorder, moderate: Continue current plan. Pt to continue avoiding alcohol. Encourage continued participation in support groups as desired.
2. Hypertension: Continue Lisinopril 10mg QD.
3. Hyperlipidemia: Continue Atorvastatin 20mg QD.
Follow up in 3 months.

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Alcohol use disorder, moderate or severe, in remission: F10.21, alcohol dependence in remission (HCC 139).

distractors.why: Moderate or severe use disorder is dependence (F10.2-).

hccs.label: Alcohol Use Disorder/Moderate/Severe/Alcohol Use with Specified Non-Psychotic Complications
